video_title: LIVE: Pelicans vs. Clippers Postgame Interviews 11/27/2026

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the importance of closing out close games
quotes.excerpt: those guys were great down the stretch finding ways to execute and get stops

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Nobody said it was going to be easy, but you were able to start the road trip off with a win. You talked about closing games. We talked about it after practice on Wednesday. You had to get a stop up three. It's not going to be in the box score, but that play Trey Murphy made on Darius Garland really was the play of the game if you look back on it.

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: I thought those guys were great down the stretch finding ways to execute and get stops. Once we cleaned up the glass, I thought that was a big key. I thought Eves came in there and did a heck of a job helping us finish possessions off. He ended with 12 rebounds and he did all the small things within the game. I think that was just so big for us, but everybody contributed and that's what we're going to need. We talk about by committee and everybody had a hand in on it.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley credits Trey Murphy for the game winning defensive play against Darius Garland. Mosley says the team effort on the glass and executing down the stretch were the keys to starting the road trip with a win.

structured.context: Head coach Jamahl Mosley discusses the team's performance in a close win against the Cavaliers following a practice session focused on late-game execution.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on team resilience and fighting through adversity
quotes.excerpt: no matter what the score, no matter the time, just being able to fight through the final horn

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Your team showed resilience as well, getting down early by 12 and then you make the run and get down by 10 again and you were still able to get the lead at halftime. I know you don't want to put yourself in those positions to come back, but the fact that you did says something about your team.

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: We've got to continue to fight and I think that's what these guys showed tonight is that, no matter what the score, no matter the time, just being able to fight through the final horn. And these guys did that. I think Herb was unbelievable down the stretch, came up with a big play. Just again, small pieces from each guy was something big. Guys coming off the bench stepping up, stepping in. They had 66 points in the paint last time, tonight they only have 34, so I think that's big and that's key for us to keep teams out of the paint but be able to also get out to three-point shooters.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley praises his team for fighting through early deficits. He highlights the defensive improvement in the paint, noting the team held the opponent to 34 points in the paint after allowing 66 in their previous matchup.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley praises his team's resilience and defensive effort in limiting the Clippers' paint scoring during a comeback victory.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the performance of Zion Williamson and Trey Murphy
quotes.excerpt: Trey did a great job of not hunting but just trying to find the right play

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Your top two scorers, Zion and Trey, led the way with 25 apiece and they did it in their own separate ways. Just talk about what those two guys did tonight.

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: I thought Trey did a great job of not hunting but just trying to find the right play, took what the defense gave him, got downhill a couple times, finished around the rim. Z same thing, wasn't afraid to step into his shot as they were going under on screens. But again, finding what the game is giving you and they and they took that and just being able to put the ball in their hands in big moments was good for us.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley on Zion Williamson and Trey Murphy scoring 25 points each. Mosley says both players did a great job of not hunting shots and simply taking what the defense gave them throughout the game.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley evaluates the offensive contributions of Zion Williamson and Trey Murphy after both players scored 25 points in the win.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on validating recent practice efforts
quotes.excerpt: these are the things, these are why the previous games they teach you lessons

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Again, just how you finished and what you'd been talking about and practicing, how big was it and important was it to validate what you guys have been working on and getting done?

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: These are the things, these are why the previous games they teach you lessons and so you got to continue to learn from those lessons. You're in a close game the other night, you're in a close game tonight. What do you do in those moments? It talks about coming up with the big stops, being able to come across the lane on the weak side, coming up with a big defensive rebound to not allow them to get another possession, communicating our switches out. All those things are key and then we had some great looks down the stretch with our execution, shots just didn't fall, but our ability to know what we're working on, know what we're doing in those big moments is going to be key as we continue to move forward and trusting that process of what we're doing.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says the team is learning from previous close game losses. He emphasizes the importance of trusting the process and focusing on defensive stops and communication in high pressure moments.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley explains the importance of applying lessons learned from previous close games to current late-game execution.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on team confidence heading into Portland
quotes.excerpt: they're physical, they're long, they're big, they get after you defensively

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Starting the road trip, all the streaks end tonight, hadn't won in this building, hadn't beaten the Clippers in a while and you end the four-game winning streak. Now confidence-wise, heading into a pretty tough place to play on Sunday.

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: They're playing great basketball and I think our guys know that. They've watched them play, they're physical, they're long, they're big, they get after you defensively. They have obviously a big-time scoring that they're capable of doing, but our guys are knowing walking into that building how we've got to sit down and guard, how we've got to communicate and just continue to take this momentum into into Portland.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says the team is ready for the challenge in Portland. He notes that the players are aware of the physicality and defensive intensity they will face on Sunday.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley discusses carrying momentum from a road win over the Clippers into an upcoming game against the Trail Blazers.
